:- module(main, [main/0]).

main :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L),
    phrase(nums(L), [M, N]),
    unique_paths(M, N, R),
    format("~d~n", [R]).

nums([]) --> [].
nums([C|T]) --> {code_type(C, space)}, nums(T).
nums([C|T]) --> {char_type(C, digit)}, !,
    digits(T, Ds, Rest),
    {number_codes(N, [C|Ds])},
    nums(Rest), [N].
nums([C|T]) --> [C], nums(T).

digits([C|T], [C|Ds], Rest) :- char_type(C, digit), !, digits(T, Ds, Rest).
digits(L, [], L).

unique_paths(1, _, 1) :- !.
unique_paths(_, 1, 1) :- !.
unique_paths(M, N, R) :-
    N2 is N - 1,
    length(Dp, N2),
    maplist(=(1), Dp),
    rows(1, M, Dp, Final),
    last(Final, R).

rows(M, M, Dp, Dp) :- !.
rows(I, M, Dp, Final) :-
    I < M,
    prefix_sum(Dp, NewDp),
    I1 is I + 1,
    rows(I1, M, NewDp, Final).

prefix_sum([X], [X]).
prefix_sum([X,Y|T], [X|Rest]) :-
    Z is X + Y,
    prefix_sum([Z|T], Rest).
```
